$description: Scene photographs for MARKET surfaces (heroes, category tiles, story panels). Unsplash Licence: free to use and modify, credit given anyway. Downloaded into raw/scenes/ (git-ignored) and prepared by scenes.py into web/public/images/scenes/: cropped to the slot's shape, given one warm matte grade so the set reads as one shoot, and darkened at the bottom where white text sits over the photograph. Captions never claim a place or a business the source does not state.
